embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: Pixels to Keys: Exploring Spatial and Motion Cues in Gameplay Inverse Dynamics
fields.value: NVIDIA — The paper studies Inverse Dynamics Models (IDMs) that recover a player's keyboard/mouse inputs purely from gameplay video, since gameplay footage rarely comes with recorded inputs.

fields.name: MotionInsight: Diagnosing Object Motion Deficiencies in Generated Videos
fields.value: ByteDance Inc.; other authors from MMLab CUHK, Peking University, Fudan University, CPII under InnoHK — The paper introduces MotionInsight, an evaluator that diagnoses object-motion deficiencies (object consistency, motion continuity, physical plausibility) in AI-generated videos, paired with the VidMotion dataset of 6,879 annotated videos with 12 failure-cause categories.

fields.name: MeteoVerse: Unified Weather-Controllable Video World Model
fields.value: Huawei; other authors from Harbin Institute of Technology. FLAG: borderline — MeteoVerse is a video world model that generates future video conditioned on scene description, weather instruction, and camera path, explicitly modeling weather transitions (preserving, introducing, or removing rain/snow/fog with intensity control) rather than leaving them implicit.

fields.name: LIFT: Layout-In-Future Video Generation under Large Viewpoint Change via On-Policy Self-Distillation
fields.value: Meta; Amazon — LIFT is a controllable video generation framework combining camera-trajectory control with "Layout-In-Future" control, letting users specify object content and spatial position in future frames.

fields.name: Imagine3D-LLM: Teaching MLLMs to Imagine 3D Scenes Before Answering
fields.value: Google — The paper trains multimodal LLMs to build a compact 3D scene representation before answering spatial questions, rather than reasoning directly over raw pixels.

fields.name: Eulerian Motion Reconstruction for Water Scenery
fields.value: Meta — The paper reconstructs a loopable 4D representation of water scenes from monocular video by combining canonical 3D Gaussian splats, a static 3D Eulerian velocity field, and a time-varying residual deformation field, with Gaussians advected via forward Euler integration and cyclically reborn with sta

fields.name: AESOP: Asymmetric Human-Camera Generation with Translation-Intensity Control
fields.value: Tencent; Jingzhong Lin completed this work during a Tencent internship — AESOP is a unified framework for both standalone camera-trajectory generation and joint human-camera generation, using an independent human-motion pathway plus a shared human-conditioned camera module.

fields.name: TaoTex: Boosting Texture Detail Fidelity for Native 3D Material Generation
fields.value: Alibaba Group — TaoTex is a diffusion-based model for native 3D material/texture generation that targets texture-detail fidelity, using a data construction agent, multi-level feature fusion, and a latent-to-pixel loss transition.

fields.name: Proxy2World: Learning to Generate Worlds From Lightweight Proxies without Seeing Them
fields.value: Tencent — Proxy2World is a controllable world model that learns to generate high-fidelity video worlds conditioned on lightweight geometric proxies, without requiring paired proxy-video training data.

fields.name: Providing Rapid Design Feedback for 3D Obstacle Course Games Using Constrained Solvability Queries
fields.value: Roblox; other authors solely at Stanford University — The paper presents an interactive design tool that gives 3D obstacle-course game designers rapid feedback by answering "constrained solvability queries" (e.g., can a waypoint be reached while avoiding a region, within a jump/time budget) using a GPU-accelerated digital-twin simulator built on the Ma

fields.name: Precise Editing and Flexible Referencing for Interactable Worlds
fields.value: StepFun (flag) — The paper introduces EditWorld, a video world model (referred to as "EditWorld" throughout the paper body) that extends interactive world modeling from pure exploration to precise, streaming content editing with flexible reference images.

fields.name: Learning What to Recall: Adaptive Multi-Cue Episodic Memory for World Models
fields.value: Sony Group Corporation — The paper proposes Future-Aware Recall (FAR), a method for world models to learn which past episodic memories are useful for predicting future observations, using future-aware predictive supervision and adaptive multi-cue scoring (temporal, pose, visual, audio).

fields.name: LEGO-Anything: Coding Agents for 3D Scene Reconstruction
fields.value: AWS; Xirui Li is at University of Maryland, College Park, with the work done during an AWS internship — LEGO-Anything reframes single-image 3D scene reconstruction as an "Image-to-Code" problem, where general-purpose coding agents iteratively write, execute, and refine Blender programs that render and are compared against the input image, producing an editable, queryable 3D scene as executable code ra

fields.name: FlowAct-R2: Beyond Talking Avatar via Streaming Multimodal References and Proactive Agent Planning
fields.value: ByteDance Intelligent Creation — FlowAct-R2 is a streaming talking-avatar system that adapts a video generation backbone (Seedance 2.0 Mini) to accept continuously changing multimodal references (image/audio/video) alongside a "Proactive Interaction Agent" that plans and schedules behavior in real time.

fields.name: FlexiWorld: Learning and Planning via Flexible Action Chunks Across Multiple Time Scales
fields.value: Tencent Jarvis Lab — FlexiWorld is a JEPA-based world model that plans using variable-length action chunks across multiple time scales, jointly training a world model, causal action encoder, and autoregressive actor.
